issuanceInfo.title: Request your digital attestation
issuanceInfo.description: We will guide you step by step to get your verifiable attestation in your Digital Wallet. It only takes a few minutes.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.title: What is the Digital Identity Wallet?
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.description: A digital identity wallet lets you keep and present your verifiable attestations from your own Wallet, without passwords or paperwork.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature1.title: Top security
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature1.descripti: Your attestations are verified cryptographically and only you decide when to share them.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature2.title: From your phone
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature2.descripti: Keep your attestation in your Digital Wallet and present it from any device.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature3.title: You are in control
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature3.descripti: You decide what to share and with whom, every time.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature4.title: Officially valid
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature4.descripti: Attestations issued and verified according to the European digital identity standards.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.title: How it works
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step1.title: Verify your identity
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step1.descriptio: Confirm who you are securely to start the process.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step2.title: Receive your attestation
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step2.descriptio: The system issues your verifiable digital attestation.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step3.title: Keep it in your Wallet
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step3.descriptio: Add it to your Digital Wallet and it is ready to use.
issuanceInfo.hero.help.ariaLabel: Ask support for help with an incident
issuanceInfo.help.title: Need help?
issuanceInfo.help.description: Our team is available to answer your questions and help you through the process

error.config-unavailable.title: You cannot continue right now
error.config-unavailable.description: We could not load the portal. Try again in a few minutes.
error.identification-failed.title: Identification was not completed
error.identification-failed.description: We could not complete your identification. You can try again.
error.not-entitled.title: You are not entitled to this attestation
error.not-entitled.description: According to our records, you are not entitled to this attestation. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
error.source-unavailable.title: We cannot check your details right now
error.source-unavailable.description: We could not check your details at the moment. Try again later.
error.issuance-failed.title: We could not generate your attestation
error.issuance-failed.description: There was a problem generating your attestation. You can try again with the same details.
error.onboarding-unavailable.title: We could not prepare your wallet sign-up
error.onboarding-unavailable.description: No attestation has been issued. You can generate a new code without identifying yourself again.
error.offer-not-renewable.title: This code can no longer be renewed
error.offer-not-renewable.description: If you have already saved the attestation in your wallet, there is nothing else to do.
error.session-expired.title: Your session has expired
error.session-expired.description: Too much time has passed without activity and your details have been deleted. You need to start again.
